damage.source: GOB 331 has one instant fixed viral health component of 29.

damage.test: LogicCannonTwoUsesItsAuthoredViralBaseWithoutLegacyDamageEndpoints covers the fixed value. Stock PR1077 verifies both actual damage values.

source-parity.runtime: The supported route uses the authored component, the original visible hostile and ordinary typed mitigation at landing.
source-parity.test: HackerHarmfulCodeTiersMode replays the retained 331 request exactly except for its rebound target. Stock PR1077 verifies current selected delivery and separate recipient mitigation.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 331 supplies the selected hostile, Hacker Style, out-of-combat admission, eight-second cast and own/shared 15-second reuse.
behavior-tests.runtime: Admission checks precede payment. Completion reuses the locked visible target, ordinary viral contest, fixed health component and typed mitigation.
behavior-tests.test: HackerHarmfulCodeTiersMode and stock PR1077 cover refusal and both selected hits. The headless replay also verifies the 15-second timer bytes for the parent and family.

damage.source: Retained 424–444 effective DOT band and the shipped 2.5 s ViralDOT update, together with the typed resistance curve.
damage.runtime: Each recipient rolls a pool independently, scales with current caster influence and takes five mitigated viral ticks before the 15 s expiration.
damage.test: HackerPlagueZoneTwoMode checks pool bounds and all five damage records, on both a neutral and a protected target. Stock PR1076 confirms 103 on the neutral target and raw101/final83 on the protected edge.

targeting.test: PR1076 verifies range refusal, exact 5.00/5.01 inclusion, ally exclusion and live original-target fizzle. Earlier native PR316 shows an actual deflection with no DOT.

behavior-tests.test: HackerPlagueZoneTwoMode verifies full exact replay, admission and fizzle, own reuse, the recipient ledger and both expirations. Native PR1076 confirms the mitigation and original-target fizzle.
